notes.model: The owner's Heavy Anti-Armor Rocket Launcher (Meshy, owned; content/guns.json, 2026-11-28): 1.1 m, held copies a 50,000-triangle cut; the tube rests on the shoulder behind its pistol grip, aimed from a sight line beside the tube as on a real AT4 (content/sight-fit.json), so its wide rear flare stays out of the middle of the view. The kit rocket launcher is the fallback.
notes.description: A slow rocket with a big blast. Aim where they will be, not where they are.
notes.vehicleDamage: Rockets hurt vehicles (owner, 2026-11-08): twice what they do to anyone else, impact and blast, before a vehicle's armour (the Tank's blasts 1.25). Against the Tank: a side hit 2 x (impact + full splash) x 1.25, so a Rocket Launcher's 160 is 400 (3 to kill it, 4 at an angle; was 6), a Guided Rocket's 165 is 412 (3). Players take the same as before.
notes.design: Benchmark rocket: rewards predicting where they will be. A slow 30 m/s rocket (a runner moves 4 m while it crosses 25 m), a 5 m blast and a direct hit that kills outright; your own blast hurts you three quarters as much. Quick to bring back: a rocket every 1.5 s, fire again as soon as it is loaded.
